mapper.select:
SELECT todo.id, todo.title, todo.summary, todo.category, todo.follows, todo.status, todo.created_on, todo.updated_on, todo.due_on, todo.completed_on, todo.details, todo.result, todo.version,
(SELECT n.name FROM category n WHERE n.id = todo.category) AS categoryDisplay,
(SELECT n.title FROM todo n WHERE n.id = todo.follows) AS followsDisplay,
FROM todo
AND todo.id = #{input.id}

SELECT c.tag_id FROM todo_tags c
WHERE c.todo_id = #{k0} ORDER BY c.seq

SELECT c.* FROM todo_comments c
WHERE c.todo_id = #{k0} ORDER BY c.seq

SELECT c.* FROM todo_history c
WHERE c.todo_id = #{k0} ORDER BY c.seq

SELECT c.* FROM todo_task c
WHERE c.todo_id = #{k0} AND c.deleted = false ORDER BY c.seq
SELECT n.name FROM todo_tags c JOIN tag n ON c.tag_id = n.id WHERE c.todo_id = #{k0} ORDER BY c.seq

SELECT todo.id, todo.title, todo.id AS column0,
todo.title AS column1,
FROM todo
ORDER BY todo.id asc

SELECT todo.id, todo.title, todo.status, todo.due_on, todo.completed_on, todo.id AS column0,
todo.title AS column1,
todo.status AS column2,
todo.due_on AS column3,
todo.completed_on AS column4,
FROM todo
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM todo_tags l WHERE l.todo_id = todo.id AND l.tag_id IN #{item})1 = 0
AND todo.category = #{input.category}
AND todo.status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS')
AND todo.due_on IS NOT NULL
AND todo.due_on < #{input.today}
ORDER BY todo.due_on asc NULLS last

SELECT todo.id, todo.summary, todo.category, todo.status, todo.created_on, todo.updated_on, todo.due_on, todo.id AS column0,
(SELECT n.name FROM category n WHERE n.id = todo.category) AS column1,
todo.status AS column2,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todo_task c WHERE c.todo_id = todo.id
AND c.done = true
AND c.deleted = false
) AS column3Done,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todo_task c WHERE c.todo_id = todo.id
AND c.deleted = false
) AS column3All,
todo.due_on AS column5,
todo.summary AS column6,
todo.created_on AS column7,
todo.updated_on AS column8,
FROM todo
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM todo_tags l WHERE l.todo_id = todo.id AND l.tag_id IN #{item})1 = 0
AND todo.category = #{input.category}
ORDER BY todo.id asc
SELECT n.name FROM todo_tags c JOIN tag n ON c.tag_id = n.id WHERE c.todo_id = #{k0} ORDER BY c.seq

AND LEFT(todo.id, CHAR_LENGTH('TODO-')) = 'TODO-'
ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(id) DESC, id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
